summary: 把谓语（或助动词）放到主语前面：完全倒装与部分倒装。部分倒装只把助动词/情态动词提前。

rules.title: 部分倒装（只提前助动词）
rules.detail: ① 否定副词开头：never, seldom, hardly, little, not only, no sooner...than, by no means；② Only + 状语开头；③ So/Neither/Nor 开头的「也/也不」。

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 我从未见过如此美丽的日落。

examples.en: Only in this way can we make progress.
examples.zh: 只有这样我们才能进步。

examples.en: He can swim, and so can I.

rules.title: 完全倒装（整个谓语提前）
rules.detail: ① 表示地点的副词/介词短语开头（here, there, up, down, in the room），谓语是 come/go/lie/stand/be 等不及物动词；② 表语提前（So beautiful is the scenery that...）。

examples.en: On the wall hangs a famous painting.

rules.title: 注意事项
rules.detail: 主语是人称代词时完全倒装不提前（Here comes the bus. 但 Here he comes.）；not until 开头只倒装主句；so...that 中 so + 形容词提前时主句部分倒装。

examples.en: Not until midnight did he come back.
So loudly did he speak that everyone heard him.
examples.zh: 他讲话声音那么大，大家都听见了。

pitfalls: 部分倒装漏助动词：❌ Never I have seen... → ✓ Never have I seen...
人称代词还搞完全倒装：❌ Here comes he. → ✓ Here he comes.
not until 从句也倒装：❌ Not until he came did I left...（从句不倒装，主句倒装）

questions.stem: — I have never been to Tibet. — ___.
questions.explain: 前句是否定句，「我也不」用 Neither + 助动词 + 主语，时态是现在完成时用 have。

questions.stem: Only when you lose something ___ its value.
questions.explain: Only + 时间状语从句开头，主句部分倒装：do you realize。

questions.stem: ___ that we all went out to enjoy it.
questions.explain: So + 形容词提前引起部分倒装：So fine was the weather that...。

questions.stem: Not until the child fell asleep ___ the room.
questions.explain: not until 开头，主句部分倒装：did the mother leave；从句不倒装。

questions.stem: Look! There ___ (go) the last bus!（用所给动词适当形式，完全倒装）
questions.explain: There/Here 开头主语是名词时完全倒装：There goes the last bus。

questions.stem: Hardly ___ he ___ home when it began to rain. (two words: arrive 关系缺失—用 get；填 had, got)
questions.explain: Hardly had sb done... when...（刚……就……）固定倒装结构。

questions.stem: Seldom he goes to the movies on weekdays.
questions.explain: seldom 否定副词开头引起部分倒装：Seldom does he go...。

questions.stem: 他不仅会说英语，还会说法语。（翻译整句，not only）
answer: not only can he speak english, but he can also speak french.
not only does he speak english, but he also speaks french.
questions.explain: not only 开头前半句部分倒装：not only can he speak...。

questions.stem: 我从来没有听说过这样的事情。（翻译整句）
answer: never have i heard of such a thing.
never have i heard of such things.
questions.explain: never 开头部分倒装：Never have I heard of...。
